correctness.rationale: The displayed adjoint-square/adjoint-cube identities follow from Cayley–Hamilton and polarizing X²=Q(X)I. Nonzero isotropic X has one-dimensional image and q² Y-preimages; nonisotropic X has orthogonal-plane image and q Y-preimages. Nilpotent Z normal form gives q² for each nonzero scalar W, while nonisotropic Z gives a unique X from W and exactly q Y-preimages iff B(Z,W)=0 and Q(W)≠0. All strata are disjoint, sum to q⁶, and exact independent 2×2 bracket enumeration agrees over four fields including F9.
